study: additional independent nonlinear generator evaluation and retrospective CarSim cross-fitting
method: V5 finite-clock/shared-field method, unchanged numerical core
generator: four-wheel nonlinear lateral/roll dynamics; load transfer, tire relaxation, longitudinal track moment
test_rule: mode=i%4; law=(i//4)%2; independently sampled vehicle parameters per seed
calibration: same activity envelope functional family as V5; max across 24 development runs times 1.25; native truth labels used only in development fit and test scoring
physical_interpretation: numeric truth uses the independently specified ODE; no measured-vehicle or additional CarSim run is claimed
crossfit_carsim: five leave-one-record-out folds with V5 calibration recipe; explicitly retrospective because all records informed earlier method development
